comment: Pinned refs for the parser-library comparison. 'old' is the version JBrowse 2
depended on at the time of the 2023 Genome Biology paper (Diesh et al. 2023);
the pin was read out of jbrowse-components at the last commit before
2023-08-15. 'new' is the current release. Both sides are cloned from GitHub at
these tags and built from source with the same toolchain, so the measured
difference is library code and not a change of transpiler target or module

extraDepsReason: v1.7.1 imports generic-filehandle without declaring it, in either
dependencies or devDependencies. Under npm's flat node_modules it
resolved anyway, hoisted out of a transitive dep; pnpm's strict layout
does not hoist, so the import fails. ^3.0.0 is the range
jbrowse-components itself pinned at the time (rev 6fb9daa575), so this
restores what a 2023 install actually resolved.
